songs.title: 🎸 She Rides the Phoenix Sky
songs.lyrics:

The low E string can be played throughout- except the Chorus

Verse 1             E/F#m6 – Em6 – Cmaj9Daiquiri wind blowing through her hair,Cigar smoke dances and she don’t care.Like a Harris hawk  she sails the phoenix sky

Freedom feeling = freedom feeling= soaring high

Verse 2             Emaj7 - Dm6 – Cmaj9

Left Texas BIG, L.A. was no funPhoenix Skys in the desert Sun.chains of blame  … all the pain,Found herself in a monsoon rain.

Chorus - Am – Em – Fmaj7She rides the Phoenix sky,Burned her past, watched it die.Flicked the ash then all kissed goodbye—She rides the Phoenix sky. 

Verse 3                Emaj7 - Dm6 – Cmaj9

The road is hard, scars she owns,in the Mesa bars,..  not to be Alone,

Storms behind her silent eyes,She’s fire under        Phoenix skies

Bridge              

  E/ F#m6 – Em6 – C maj9No map, no man, no tethered chain,Thunder storms in the  desert rain.She’s desert twilight twirl
